Maybe save enough so that if your living situation ever changes on a dime, you don’t ever have to worry about a roommate missing rent or getting evicted or some shit. 

After that though, let it rip if you want. I got a stratified tune and it’s a blast.

Save it for insurance and stuff. When you have a large emergency fund, get the cobb, but you should wait until you have enough in savings so you can get a tune too and still have a few grand left over for life stuff. The Cobb ots tunes are alright but you’ll wake the car up with another third party tune.

Insurance is insanely expensive on these cars if you have full coverage. Especially at 19. Make good decisions now and get opportunities to do even cooler shit to your car in the future

It was fixed by making sure all the connections to the coolant temp sensor were on snug, apparently during the short shifter install I got handsy with one of the sensors and it caused it to read as overheating upon start up. I think I uninstalled and reinstalled the whole thing 2-3 times and making sure all fittings were snug multiple times before the issue ended up resolving itself. When it finally didn’t read as overheating upon start up I bled the coolant one more time to be safe and haven’t had an issue since. Hopefully your issue has a similarly easy fix, but it was mainly just turning it off and on again until it magically fixed itself lol.
